direct.name: @azure/identity
direct.purpose: Server-side Azure credentials and managed identity
direct.review_focus: Credential-chain ambiguity, accidental browser import, tenant mismatch, token logging, and unmanaged retries.

direct.name: @azure/msal-browser
direct.purpose: Browser Entra session and token acquisition
direct.review_focus: Client secrets in browser code, redirect loops, stale account selection, overbroad scopes, and cache/session expiry behavior.

direct.name: @azure/msal-react
direct.purpose: React bindings for browser Entra authentication
direct.review_focus: Provider remounts, login races, missing loading/error states, and rendering protected content before authentication settles.

direct.name: @azure/storage-blob
direct.review_focus: Public containers, long-lived SAS URLs, path traversal, unbounded downloads, missing content headers, and retry amplification.

direct.name: @napi-rs/canvas
direct.review_focus: Native binary compatibility, memory exhaustion, malformed-image handling, and accidental inclusion in browser bundles.

direct.name: @playwright/test
direct.review_focus: Skipped production-critical paths, shared test state, flaky timing assertions, and tests that pass only against warm caches.

direct.name: @tailwindcss/postcss
direct.review_focus: Build-version incompatibility and generated CSS growth.

direct.name: @tesseract.js-data/eng
direct.review_focus: Runtime bundle growth, version mismatch with Tesseract, and loading data from an untrusted remote location.

direct.name: @types/node
direct.review_focus: Type/runtime version mismatch with the deployment image.

direct.name: @types/react
direct.review_focus: Type/runtime mismatch and suppressions hiding changed React behavior.

direct.name: @types/react-dom
direct.review_focus: Type/runtime mismatch and incorrect server/client assumptions.

direct.name: axe-core
direct.review_focus: Treating automated scans as complete accessibility coverage and ignoring keyboard/focus/manual checks.

direct.name: babel-plugin-react-compiler
direct.review_focus: Compiler/runtime incompatibility, changed memoization behavior, and transforms not exercised in development mode.

direct.name: eslint
direct.review_focus: Rule drift, ignored directories, and warnings that do not fail CI.

direct.name: eslint-config-next
direct.review_focus: Framework/config version mismatch and disabled server/client boundary rules.

direct.name: jose
direct.review_focus: Missing issuer/audience/algorithm checks, clock-skew mistakes, key rotation, and accepting untrusted claims as authorization.

direct.name: lucide-react
direct.review_focus: Unlabelled icon-only controls, inconsistent sizing, and importing the full icon set into client bundles.

direct.name: next
direct.review_focus: Server/client boundary leaks, cache semantics, route-handler behavior, dynamic rendering drift, and framework-version API changes.

direct.name: pdfjs-dist
direct.purpose: PDF parsing, page rendering, and previews
direct.review_focus: Worker configuration, malformed/oversized PDFs, page-count limits, memory cleanup, CSP compatibility, and version drift.

direct.name: postcss
direct.review_focus: Plugin ordering, parser vulnerabilities, and output differences between local and CI builds.

direct.name: postgres
direct.review_focus: Pool exhaustion, missing transaction boundaries, unsafe dynamic SQL, statement timeouts, retrying non-idempotent writes, and connection leaks.

direct.name: react
direct.review_focus: Effect races, stale closures, unstable keys, hydration mismatches, and state duplicated across server/client boundaries.

direct.name: react-dom
direct.review_focus: Hydration mismatch, focus loss, route-announcer conflicts, and browser-only APIs during server rendering.

direct.name: server-only
direct.review_focus: Missing imports in credential/data modules and false confidence when transitive client imports bypass the intended boundary.

direct.name: tailwindcss
direct.review_focus: Unbounded content scanning, stale classes, generated CSS growth, and version-specific syntax.

direct.name: tesseract.js
direct.review_focus: CPU and memory denial of service, unbounded worker creation, language-data loading, cleanup, and low-confidence output treated as truth.

direct.name: typescript
direct.purpose: Static type checking and compiler APIs
direct.review_focus: Compiler-version drift, skipped checks, broad assertions, and emitted/runtime behavior assumed from types.
